title: flexyBayes: validation and benchmark study
note: ALL FOUR flagship cards RUN with real numbers against independent oracles (no fabrication). One formula spec, validated across all three backends (INLA exact-deterministic; greta TF-HMC; brms Stan-HMC) plus a fixed-effects exactness card. Numbers computed by bench/*.R, cached to bench/results/*.rds; cards never hand-type them. api_surface_covered left null (N/A): a flagship correctness subset of a 169-export package, not a full-surface claim.

cards.title: fb/flexybayes: Gaussian fixed-effects recovery vs lm() (exact)
fb_inla: sleepstudy LMM vs standalone INLA + lme4 (3-way)

conformance_cells.result: flexyBayes-via-INLA == standalone INLA (delta 0, exact translation); within 1.5*SE of lme4 REML

cards.title: fb_greta: sleepstudy LMM via greta/TF-HMC vs lme4

conformance_cells.result: agrees with lme4 within 1.5*SE (Intercept 247.9 vs 251.4; Days 10.53 vs 10.47)
conformance_cells.caveat: the package flagged non-convergence at modest warmup (Rhat up to 2.66, min ESS 16) -- raise warmup/n_samples for a publication fit; the agreement test still passes within tolerance

cards.title: fb_brms: sleepstudy LMM via brms/Stan-HMC vs standalone brms + lme4

conformance_cells.result: Days slope agrees across fb-brms 10.48 / standalone brms 10.43 / lme4 10.47 (delta 0.01)
conformance_cells.finding: only the Days term matched by name across all three; the Intercept differs in canonical naming (fb_brms coef() vs brms::fixef vs lme4::fixef) and was excluded -- a real canonical-naming follow-up, not a numeric disagreement
